purpose: Privacy modes enforced at the capability boundary, plus a personal tool registry with typed effects, receipts, and honest implemented/declared split.

privacy_modes.law: Modes are enforced at the capability boundary, not by asking a subsystem to behave. A network-disabled session must not be able to construct a network-capable connector handle at all.

connector_disabled.effect: ConnectorCapableHandle::try_construct fails; network may still construct

ephemeral_no_memory.effect: PrivacySession allows working only; durable class writes refuse; end() purges session refs so durable_refs_after == 0

encrypted_vault.effect: private_vault scope writes require EncryptedVaultHandle; ordinary write_* with PrivateVault scope fails closed

types.EncryptedVaultHandle: try_construct only when encrypted_vault is active
types.PrivacySession: session_id + policy; durable writes gated; end() produces EphemeralEndReport

construction_not_call_refusal.property: Tests assert try_construct returns Err, not that a method on an existing handle refuses

ephemeral_property.name: property_ephemeral_means_ephemeral_no_durable_trace
proves: accidental session-linked durable rows are purged on end

effect_path.law: High-risk external actions are never silently executed — they need the effect system.
effect_path.silent_path: execute_without_receipt always fails when requires_receipt is true

fixtures.calculator: pure arithmetic left-to-right; no receipt required
fixtures.task_lists: in-memory tasks; add/list/complete/remove; requires receipt; rollback restores snapshot

tests.name: property_network_disabled_cannot_construct_network_handle
tests.proves: construction fails under network_disabled and local_offline

tests.name: property_connector_disabled_cannot_construct_connector_handle
tests.proves: connector construct fails; network still constructs under connector_disabled alone

tests.name: property_ephemeral_means_ephemeral_no_durable_trace
tests.proves: ephemeral session leaves no durable episodic/user/verification trace

tests.name: property_ephemeral_end_purges_accidental_session_refs
tests.proves: end() purges durable session_id refs even if written outside the wrapper

tests.name: property_high_risk_external_actions_never_silent
tests.proves: task_lists refuses silent execute; deny-by-default; single-use receipt; second use fails

tests.name: property_calculator_fixture_pure_compute
tests.proves: calculator runs without receipt against fixture expression

tests.name: property_task_lists_rollback
tests.proves: rollback token restores prior task map

tests.name: property_declared_tools_non_constructible
tests.proves: 13 declared tools refuse construct; each declares non-empty typed effects

tests.name: property_no_hidden_permanent_memory_inspect_and_forget
tests.proves: cross-cutting: inspect + real forget + portable export

non_goals: No real network, credentials, or model
No real MCP bridge, shell, or email send
Vault encryption is handle-level only; OS crypto deferred

hard_constraint_inherited.no_production_claim: Fixtures and mocks never earn PRODUCTION
